"title":"Organize estate planning file",
"text":"Organize Lydia Cloudpuddle’s estate planning file to separate probate assets, beneficiary assets, estate professional contacts, family decision points, and household planning impacts, facilitating clear coordination of the inherited assets.",

"subTasks":[],

},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Address inherited IRA claim packet",
"text":"Address Lydia Cloudpuddle’s inherited IRA claim packet for Velvet Acorn Custody by securing a certified death certificate, letters of authority, and a completed claim form, replacing the current photocopy and unsigned draft.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-08-01",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to address the claim-packet requirements by 2025-08-01."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Determine Tin Sparrow account ownership",
"text":"Determine the appropriate ownership treatment for the Tin Sparrow Investments account, which currently shows a transfer-on-death registration to Lydia and Calvin but is also listed as a probate asset, to finalize estate accounting.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-08-15",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The ownership treatment remains unresolved before estate accounting can be finalized, with follow-up needed by 2025-08-15."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Prepare condominium expense cash-flow calendar",
"text":"Prepare a cash-flow calendar for the condominium expenses, detailing recurring costs, sale-preparation fees, estate-paid items, and any personal advances by co-executors, to enable fair coordination with Calvin.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-08-06",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to prepare that calendar by 2025-08-06."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Complete inherited IRA distribution review",
"text":"Complete a review of inherited IRA distribution options for Lydia Cloudpuddle, analyzing taxable income impacts, withholding preferences, and pacing scenarios to align with her planned retirement at age 62.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-09-05",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to complete that review by 2025-09-05."
},
{
"templateId":"c0849ab3-1ea7-5ae4-8eb0-302abcb9d836",
"title":"Perform recurring beneficiary designation review",
"text":"At each annual review cycle, and after any reported major life event, confirm whether beneficiary designations should be reviewed for retirement accounts, insurance policies, transfer-on-death registrations, and education accounts. Document the date of the last confirmed beneficiary review, evidence available, discrepancies found, and any forms or custodian steps needed. Lydia Cloudpuddle wants equal contingent beneficiary treatment for her children Mara and Theo across all retirement accounts. Ensure both are listed as contingent beneficiaries in the IRA, 401(k), and other retirement vehicles.",
"priority":"medium",
"dueDate":"2025-08-22",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to address the beneficiary alignment by 2025-08-22."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Obtain estate professional communication authorization",
"text":"Obtain written authorization from Lydia Cloudpuddle allowing Sienna Bramblequill of Paper Otter Legal to discuss asset values, beneficiary registrations, basis information, and liquidity questions with Apricot Compass Advisory and Clockwork Clover Tax.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-07-30",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to obtain the authorization by 2025-07-30."
},
{
"templateId":null,
"title":"Address Velvet Acorn account name correction",
"text":"Address the name correction for the Velvet Acorn Custody inherited IRA, updating the account registration from Lydia Velvetreed to Lydia Cloudpuddle to ensure proper acceptance of the inherited account paperwork.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2025-08-04",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The mismatch may prevent acceptance of inherited account paperwork unless the custodian corrects the registration workflow, and the agreed follow-up is to address the name correction by 2025-08-04."
}
]
